name: Rotary Encoder Module
fullName: KY-040 Incremental 360-Degree Rotary Encoder Module with Pushbutton
tagline: Continuous 360-degree digital dial for menus, timers, and precision navigation
description: The KY-040 rotary encoder is an incremental electro-mechanical device that converts the angular position or motion of a shaft into a sequence of digital 2-phase quadrature pulses (CLK and DT). Unlike potentiometers, it can rotate continuously without physical stops and includes a momentary push switch.
wiringNote: Connect CLK to an external interrupt pin (e.g. Arduino Pin 2 or 3) for jitter-free rotary tracking.
libraryName: Encoder (by Paul Stoffregen) or custom interrupt ISR
commonMistakes: Polling without hardware interrupts or proper debouncing causing missed ticks
Reversing CLK and DT pins causing counter to increment in reverse direction
